title: StyleWe: Towards Style Fusion in Generative Fashion Design with Efficient Federated AI
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: This paper introduces StyleWe, a federated generative AI system for fashion design that enables collaborative style fusion while protecting data privacy. It includes user studies and technical evaluations.
